observations: Three photos show a black, square-shaped console with a textured surface, likely a game console.
The console has a PlayStation logo (PS) centered on the front face.
Four directional buttons (triangle, circle, cross, square) are visible on the top face, arranged in a diamond pattern.
The console appears to be closed and not powered on.
No model number or serial number is visible on any photo.
The background is a wooden surface with a colorful abstract painting.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'WILCOX HARRY' are overlaid on all photos.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4
claims.evidence: The claim is about GPU power, which cannot be verified from photos alone. No technical specs or labels are visible.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or damaged internally.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number label on the back or bottom of the console, or a video showing the console's system settings screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic console, not PS4 Pro

risks.risk: The console may be missing essential components (e.g., power cable, HDMI cable, controller).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number label on the back or bottom of the console.
Video showing the console powering on and booting up.
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
Photo of the console's system settings screen to confirm model and software version.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
